title: 黄仁勋：我们加速全球每一个AI模型
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Gents, and on the earnings call last week, you talked about, we've confidence, right?
segments.zh: 先生们，在上周的财报电话会议上，你们谈到了我们有信心，对吧？

segments.en: The GPU-based architecture has superior economics.
segments.zh: 基于GPU的架构具有更优的经济性。

segments.en: You were talking about that in the context of the frontier labs, largely because you were asked about custom silicon.
segments.zh: 你们是在前沿实验室的背景下谈论这个的，主要是因为你们被问到了定制芯片。

segments.en: The simple terms of it is that NVLink fusion just makes it easy to take XPU and just drop it into the data center.
segments.zh: 简单来说，NVLink Fusion使得将XPU轻松接入数据中心成为可能。

segments.en: That would show that Nvidia does see XPU coming into the market.
segments.zh: 这表明英伟达确实看到了XPU进入市场。

segments.en: Is the difference if you're thinking this week to what you outlined last week?
segments.zh: 本周你的想法与上周概述的有何不同？

segments.en: I see XPUs in the market. It's not coming into the market, it's in the market.
segments.zh: 我看到XPU已经在市场中了，不是即将进入，而是已经存在。

segments.en: Look, an XPU is a specialized chip.
Nvidia's GPU is a general purpose accelerator.
segments.zh: 英伟达的GPU是通用加速器。

segments.en: We accelerate the entire lifecycle of AI from data processing, which data processing, the pre-training to post-training to agent AI inferencing.
segments.zh: 我们加速AI的整个生命周期，从数据处理（包括数据预处理、预训练、后训练）到智能体AI推理。

segments.en: We accelerate every single AI model in the world, from closed models, every closed model, every open model, video models and language models, biological models and physics models
segments.zh: 我们加速世界上每一个AI模型，包括闭源模型、开源模型、视频模型、语言模型、生物模型和物理模型

segments.en: and robotics models. We literally accelerate every single area of AI.
segments.zh: 以及机器人模型。我们确实加速了AI的每一个领域。
